lodged.configuration.title: %s Configuration
lodged.configuration.enableArrowRecovery: Tracked lodged arrows can drop from living entities when they die.
lodged.configuration.recoveryChance.tool: Chance for each tracked lodged arrow to drop on death.
lodged.configuration.maxTrackedArrowsPer: Maximum lodged arrows stored on a single entity. Set to 0 to disable tracking.
lodged.configuration.recoverPlayerArrows: Only arrows fired by players can be recovered.
lodged.configuration.recoverInfinityArro: Survival Infinity-generated arrows can be recovered from entity death drops and player body removal.
lodged.configuration.recoverCreativeArro: Arrows fired by creative-mode players can be recovered.
lodged.configuration.preserveArrowItemSt: Store the original arrow ItemStack so spectral and tipped arrow data can be recovered.
lodged.configuration.preventPlayerArrowD: Arrows stuck in players will not naturally despawn from the vanilla stuck-arrow renderer.
lodged.configuration.preventNonPlayerArr: Arrows stuck in non-player living entities will not naturally despawn from the vanilla stuck-arrow renderer.
lodged.configuration.enablePlayerArrowRe: Players can remove arrows lodged in their own body from the inventory player preview.
lodged.configuration.playerArrowRemovalH: Chance that removing a player arrow from the head succeeds and recovers the arrow item.
lodged.configuration.playerArrowRemovalC: Chance that removing a player arrow from the chest succeeds and recovers the arrow item.
lodged.configuration.playerArrowRemovalA: Chance that removing a player arrow from an arm succeeds and recovers the arrow item.
lodged.configuration.playerArrowRemovalL: Chance that removing a player arrow from a leg succeeds and recovers the arrow item.
lodged.configuration.playerArrowRemovalI: Multiplier applied to player arrow removal success chance for Infinity-generated arrows. This only applies when Recover Infinity arrows is enabled.
lodged.configuration.playerArrowRemovalB: Damage dealt when player arrow removal fails and breaks the arrow. Damage is in half-hearts, so 2.0 equals one heart.
lodged.configuration.allowArrowRemovalIn: Creative-mode players may remove arrows lodged in their own body.
lodged.configuration.requireInventoryScr: Removal requests are only accepted while the player is in their own inventory menu.
lodged.configuration.maxRemovablePlayerA: Maximum player lodged arrows exposed to the inventory removal UI. Set to 0 to follow max tracked arrows per entity.
lodged.configuration.entityDenylist.tool: Entity type IDs that should never track or drop lodged arrows.
lodged.configuration.enableBleeding.tool: Lodged can apply its bleeding mob effect.
lodged.configuration.arrowRemovalCausesB: Pulling lodged arrows out of your body can apply bleeding.
lodged.configuration.enchantsCauseBleedi: Weapons with enchantments in Lodged's bleeding enchantment tags can apply bleeding.
lodged.configuration.weaponsCauseBleedin: Unenchanted weapons in the lodged:bleeding_weapons item tag can apply bleeding.
lodged.configuration.skeletonsAffectedBy: Entity types in lodged:bleeding_skeletons can bleed.
lodged.configuration.undeadAffectedByBle: Undead entity types in lodged:bleeding_undead can bleed.
lodged.configuration.fullArmorPreventsBl: Wearing armor in all four normal armor slots prevents new bleeding.
lodged.configuration.partialArmorPrevent: Wearing any normal armor piece prevents new bleeding.
lodged.configuration.fullArmorBleedingCh: Chance for bleeding to apply with full armor when full armor prevention is disabled.
lodged.configuration.partialArmorBleedin: Chance for bleeding to apply with one to three armor pieces.
lodged.configuration.noArmorBleedingChan: Chance for bleeding to apply with no armor pieces.
lodged.configuration.failedArrowRemovalF: Failed arrow removal full armor bleeding chance
Chance for failed arrow removal to apply bleeding with full armor.
lodged.configuration.failedArrowRemovalP: Failed arrow removal partial armor bleeding chance
Chance for failed arrow removal to apply bleeding with one to three armor pieces.
lodged.configuration.failedArrowRemovalN: Failed arrow removal no armor bleeding chance
Chance for failed arrow removal to apply bleeding with no armor pieces.
lodged.configuration.bleedingDamageDurat: Bleeding duration added by qualifying weapon damage.
lodged.configuration.bleedingArrowRemova: Bleeding duration added by pulling out a lodged arrow.
lodged.configuration.bleedingMaxDuration: Maximum bleeding duration after stacking repeated triggers.
lodged.configuration.bleedingStrongDurat: Bleeding becomes stronger at or above this remaining duration.
lodged.configuration.bleedingBaseTickInt: Ticks between damage pulses for normal bleeding.
lodged.configuration.bleedingStrongTickI: Ticks between damage pulses for strong bleeding.
Damage dealt by each normal bleeding pulse.
lodged.configuration.bleedingStrongDamag: Damage dealt by each strong bleeding pulse.
lodged.configuration.bleedingDripParticl: Bleeding entities drip blood particles from their wound between damage pulses.
lodged.configuration.bleedingBaseDripInt: Ticks between blood drip particles for normal bleeding.
lodged.configuration.bleedingStrongDripI: Ticks between blood drip particles for strong bleeding.
